description: Administrator only. The enabled configuration is checked by HTTPS discovery before saving. Supply the revision returned by GET; stale updates are rejected.

issuer.description: HTTPS issuer URL; may be empty when disabled.

public_url.description: HTTPS origin of the NPM admin interface; may be empty when disabled.

scopes.description: Space-separated scopes including openid when enabled.

revision.description: Opaque revision used for optimistic concurrency.

client_secret.description: A nonempty value replaces the secret. An empty string retains the saved secret. A secret is required to enable OIDC.

200.description: Saved settings without the client secret.

400.description: Invalid fields, discovery failure, or stale revision.

401.description: Invalid, expired or revoked bearer token.
